steps: Research first. Call diligence-dh.build_company_profile for the company the buyer names, then commercial-dh.screen_commercial_peers for the segment the buyer names. The alternatives for the next step are the companies that research returned.
Use what that research collected. Call analytics.mcda with those alternatives and with the scores and weights the buyer types. Do not invent a score. If a score is missing, leave that option blank.
When the buyer supplies numeric features for at least two of those companies, call analytics.segmentation. Do not invent a feature. A company without features stays out of the cluster.
Show the weights and scores beside the rank. Label which names came from the dossier or the peer screen.
Do not store the scores or the features.
